command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp/meg
bad=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r f vid md5 bytes; do
  [ "$f" = file ] && continue
  got=$(md5sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  if [ "$got" = "$md5" ]; then echo "$f md5 == OpenNeuro ETag (version $vid)"; else echo "FAIL: $f md5 $got, OpenNeuro ETag $md5"; bad=1; fi
done < /tmp/sources.tsv
[ "$bad" = 0 ] || exit 1
cd /tmp && sha256sum meg/* > /tmp/data.sha256
wc -l < /tmp/data.sha256
echo DONE
